description: This file contains functions for parsing clipboard text, converting text to HTML, and detecting Markdown syntax within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for handling Markdown and plain text, and references external modules for schema parsing, HTML encoding, and Markdown detection.

methods.name: clipboardTextParser
methods.description: Parses clipboard text into a document slice, detecting Markdown and converting accordingly.

methods.name: convertTextToHTML
methods.description: Converts plain text into HTML paragraphs with proper spacing and encoding.

methods.name: encodeLine
methods.description: Encodes non-ASCII characters and spaces in a line to HTML entities.

methods.name: isProbablyMarkdown
methods.description: Analyzes text to determine if it is likely Markdown based on pattern matching and scoring.
